# zBTC: Bitcoin–Zenon Interoperability Protocol Specification — `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`)

> Public RFC `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`, Tier F): an honest, capped Tapscript `OP_CHECKSIGADD` HSM federated Bitcoin peg issuing 1:1 feeless `zBTC` on Zenon's block-lattice via tranche-isolated `TreasuryTrancheEscrow` + lightweight `SettlementContract`, verified by direct-on-L1 trimmed Bitcoin SPV + `k`-of-`n` federation co-signatures, paired with peg-free PTLC adaptor swaps and Lightning submarine-swap gateways. Supersedes archived `v0` (`v2.5.0-rfc`, preserved byte-for-byte under `versions/v0/`).

- **Current Version:** `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`) — pre-implementation RFC open for independent custody/HSM & bridge review (**M-15**). NOT mainnet-active.
- **Archived Version:** `v0` (`v2.5.0-rfc`, commit `7b47b8c`, superseded — do not implement): https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/v0/
- **Changelog & Diffs (`v0 → v1`):** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/changelog/
- **Canonical Web Site:** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec
- **Single-Fetch Full Bundle (`v1`):** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/llms-full.txt
- **Consistency & Bounds Checker:** `python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`

## Normative Specification Files (`v1` / `v3.0.0-rfc`)

Read in authority-precedence order (`SPEC.md §2.1`):

- [Part 1 — Bitcoin Federated Custody (`BTC-CUSTODY-F1`) & `v2` Research Annex](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/01-bitcoin-taproot-vault-enforcement.md): Highest precedence. Taproot NUMS + `7-of-10`/`11-of-15` `OP_CHECKSIGADD` HSM leaf, `<52,560> OP_CSV` recovery leaf, mandatory `26,280`-block refresh safety duty, dual-implementation `B3a/B3b` signer conservation + `settlementCodeHash` firewall, Proof-of-Reserves, Wind-Down loss model, and Non-Normative `v2` BitVM Research Annex (Gates `R-1..R-8`). HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-01/
- [Master Overview (`SPEC.md`)](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/SPEC.md): Tier F architecture, end-to-end flows, honest threat model, complete Privileged Powers Table (`H-3`), Stage 0/1A/1B gates, `bigidea` claims alignment table, and written Q&A answering Consolidated Hostile Review `R7`. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/
- [Part 2 — Direct-on-L1 Trimmed Bitcoin SPV Verifier](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/02-btc-authorization-domain-and-spv.md): Pure-Go panic-recovered (`B1`) ABI methods (`SubmitHeaderBatch`, `StepReorg`, `PruneStaleHeaders`, `SubmitSweepLockProof`, `PostBatchIntent`, `SubmitReleaseProof`, `SubmitConflictRefundProof`), coinbase midstate proof (no streaming `0x04`), `<= 6,144 B` stripped federation tx cap, `K_pilot = 14`, explicit `minimumPostAnchorWork`, and `B2` pinned `2.1M` Plasma floor. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-02/
- [Part 3 — Lightweight Settlement, Tranche-Isolated `zBTC` & Peg-Free Rails](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md): `TreasuryTrancheEscrow` cap isolation (`H-8, B3c`), `ReserveMintCapacity` (`M-7`), Zenon-final `BatchIntent` + conflict-only refunds (`B4`), Dynamic Plasma capacity at `11.4s`/Momentum (`M-9, M-10`), hardened PTLC (`>= 72`-blk CSV, confirmed-before-refund, `T_btc_worst = 24h`) and LN gateway (`Δ_safety = 36` blks, hold-invoice rate limits, `M-4`). HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-03/
- [Part 4 — Bitcoin Anchoring & Zenon Light Client Infrastructure *(Non-Custodial)*](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/04-bitcoin-anchoring-and-light-client.md): Non-blocking for `v1` custody. Epoch-averaged slashable/beacon U2 committee (`H-1`), `<21` Pillar fallback & competing certified branches (`L-1`), quorum-only impairment (`N-1`), mandatory bountied epoch handoff anchoring & mobile header sources (`H-7`). HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-04/
- [Part 5 — Detailed `go-zenon` Node Upgrade Plan](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/05-go-zenon-upgrade-plan.md): U0 pinned to first release tag containing `0aa299e`, `DynamicPlasmaSpork` hard precondition + pinned `2.1M` Plasma floor (`B2, L-3`), issue `#239` + `recover()` FIFO receive stall gate (`B1`), lightweight U3 (`TreasuryTrancheEscrow` + `SettlementContract` + direct L1 `btcspv`), U5 governance hard gate before Stage 1B. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-05/
- [Changelog (`v0 → v1`)](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/CHANGELOG.md): Complete finding-by-finding disposition of `R7` (`C-1..C-4`, `H-1..H-8`, `M-1..M-15`, `L-1..L-4`), `N-1..N-6`, and `B1..B5`. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/changelog/

## Consistency Checker & Review Trail

- [Consistency & Bounds Checker (`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`)](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py): Run `python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py` (stdlib Python 3 only) to verify Tapscript weights, BIP-68 CSV schedule, B2 Plasma floor, `11.4s` Dynamic Plasma TPS, PTLC/LN timelocks, halving `K`, and a 2,000-step randomized simulation of `B3a/B3b/B3c/B4`. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/oracle/
